lead: `target/debug/nvs test <one-case.nvst>` runs a single case and prints its actual stdout on a mismatch
body: , so freeze an `--EXPECT--` by running the case with an *empty* one and pasting back what it printed. The report indents the output by four spaces, so de-indent the paste; and a value that can be empty or end in a space needs a delimiter in the `echo` (`"[", $x, "]"`), because a trailing space is invisible there and exact in the comparison.
